body.name: Full and certifiable confidence-feasible extrema
body.construction: Set \(\mathcal F_n=\{M\in M_G:p_M\in C_n\}\), \(\ell_n=\inf_{M\in\mathcal F_n}Q(M)\), and \(u_n=\sup_{M\in\mathcal F_n}Q(M)\). Set \(\mathcal F_{n,\mathrm{cert}}=\{M\in M_{\mathrm{cert}}:p_M\in C_n\}\), \(\ell_{n,\mathrm{cert}}=\inf_{M\in\mathcal F_{n,\mathrm{cert}}}Q(M)\), and \(u_{n,\mathrm{cert}}=\sup_{M\in\mathcal F_{n,\mathrm{cert}}}Q(M)\).
